summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of LogiLink Global package delivery application. All core functionalities working correctly including calendar loading, package creation, tracking, and backoffice management.
passed_tests: Home page loads with calendar displaying EU_TO_CM (Fridays) and CM_TO_EU (Saturdays) schedules
Package creation form (/send?dir=EU_TO_CM) successfully creates parcels with tracking ID generation
Success page displays with 'Télécharger le Ticket' button and tracking ID (LOGI-E4PN1N)
Tracking functionality (/track) successfully retrieves and displays parcel status and details
Backoffice (/backoffice) lists all parcels with status update functionality
Status updates from backoffice are reflected in tracking page
All backend APIs (schedule, parcels CRUD, PDF generation) working correctly
Parcel status progression display working correctly
